answer: The potter fires only pots stamped with his own wheel mark, and the kiln master counts them as they go in, because a pot without a mark is a pot without an owner. Cartographer survey licence with land board attestation is the wheel mark's proof: five-year licence, 200 surveyed plots, board exam, annual renewal. A pot that carries a stolen quill cracks in the firing and betrays the thief. The vault is the price of the broken ware, a whole kiln-load paid to the guild, and the knoll is the firing book, kept by the kiln master and read when the pots come out.
